evals.prompt: Run an offline software bookkeeping exercise using /workspace/input/bookkeeping.json. All scores, controls, and thresholds in this file are synthetic; do not call model APIs or describe these numbers as scientific predictions. For each profile, create a separate run directory and manifest using the supplied target, filters, ranking metric, candidates, scores, and control flags. Use the bundled manifest helper if available, or implement equivalent bookkeeping. Save and reload each manifest, apply the supplied filters, exclude controls from rankings and success counts, and export both all_candidates.csv and ranked candidates.csv. Show the resulting counts and ranked IDs for each profile. Leave absent scores absent, including ipTM for the Boltz2 profile. Label all results as simulated bookkeeping, disclose the pending candidate, and explain that these results provide no live inference coverage.
evals.expected_output: Two saved and reloaded manifests and two CSVs per profile. Each profile has four non-control candidates, two passing candidates, and one control. Both rankings contain best then boundary. Below and pending fail; the control is excluded from rankings and counts. The Boltz2 profile retains boltz2_confidence without inventing ipTM. The simulated 2/4 passing fraction is provisional because pending lacks required scores. No model calls or scientific validation claims.
assertions: [executes-bookkeeping] Executes the bookkeeping and produces a manifest and both CSV artifacts per profile; a proposed plan alone does not pass.
[resumes-state] Saves and reloads each profile without changing the supplied scores, filters, rank_by metric, or control flags.
[filters-missing-scores] Each profile reports n_candidates=4, n_passed=2, n_controls=1; below and pending fail.
[ranks-and-exports] Each ranked candidates.csv contains best then boundary, excludes the control, and all_candidates.csv retains all five entries.
[separates-metrics] Boltz2 is filtered and ranked by boltz2_confidence, with iptm_min disabled and no invented ipTM score.
[states-coverage] Labels every result as simulated offline bookkeeping, discloses the incomplete candidate and provisional 2/4 ratio, and makes no live inference or scientific validation claim.

evals.prompt: Review my protein binder campaign in /workspace/input/boltz2_only.json. Produce manifest.json, a complete all_candidates.csv audit, and ranked candidates.csv under /workspace/output/boltz2-only. Preserve the supplied policy, scores, and control flags; save and reload the manifest before reporting counts and ranked IDs. All inputs are synthetic software fixtures. Work offline and make no live inference or scientific validation claim.
evals.expected_output: The supplied composite-confidence cutoff is 0.73; ipTM remains disabled and absent. Ranked IDs are binder_a then binder_b. Counts are n_candidates=4, n_passed=2, n_controls=1; the audit retains all five entries. The sequence-only control is exempt only from RMSD. Pending lacks RMSD and low_confidence fails. The 2/4 fraction is provisional and synthetic.
assertions: [executes-export] Creates and reloads the manifest and writes both CSV artifacts under /workspace/output/boltz2-only; a plan alone does not pass.
[separate-metrics] Keeps the supplied 0.73 confidence cutoff, disabled ipTM and enabled pLDDT/RMSD filters; does not invent ipTM or rename confidence to ipTM.
[ranked-artifact] candidates.csv contains exactly binder_a then binder_b, excluding the higher-scoring control and pending.
[complete-audit] The manifest and all_candidates.csv retain all five entries; reports n_candidates=4, n_passed=2, n_controls=1.
[control-applicability] The sequence-only control has no invented RMSD or backbone and is exempt only from RMSD; its confidence and pLDDT still pass the supplied filters.
[honest-coverage] Discloses pending's missing RMSD and a provisional 2/4 fraction, labels scores synthetic, and makes no live inference or scientific validation claim.
